summary.headline: Laurentianus XXVIII, 43
summary.text: Supplementary inventory of Laurentianus XXVIII, 43, a fifteenth-century Florentine astrological manuscript containing Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos, Persian-year tables for the seven stars, Proclus’ outline of astronomical hypotheses, and a discussion of the beginning of the year.
